friction: Agent narrowly fixated on product feed categories instead of universal agent handoff (plans, specs, task context).
resolution: Extended headroom-compression to all files, plans, and inter-agent handoffs with automatic --save disk generation.

friction: Compiler errors in apps/desktop/src-tauri only discovered on full build.
resolution: Added watch:rust script and integrated cargo check into .lintstagedrc.json for instant incremental verification.

friction: LLMs can accidentally touch .env or pnpm-lock.yaml directly during edits.
resolution: Implemented SEC-10, PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json, and git pre-commit check in scripts/check-protected-files.mjs.

friction: Repeatedly querying external MCPs (context7, perplexity, firecrawl) for identical library docs wastes latency and tokens.
resolution: Created MCP Knowledge Cache (.agents/cache/mcp/, scripts/mcp-cache.mjs, mcp-knowledge-cache skill, CORE-06) with Headroom compression and OmniRoute-delegated cache refresh.

trigger: duplicate .md and .compressed.md files, router:tabular Markdown truncation, and Markdownlint errors
friction: Headroom router:tabular stripped prose sections from plans containing Markdown tables and emitted a single-line JSON-escaped string; scripts created redundant .md and .compressed.md pairs; HTML comments on line 1 violated MD041.
resolution: Codified CORE-14 in core.md, updated scripts/headroom-compress.mjs and scripts/mcp-cache.mjs to store strictly ONE .compressed.md file (auto-deleting raw duplicates), converted tables to bullets, enforced # Heading on line 1, and updated planner.md, headroom-compression, mcp-knowledge-cache, writing-plans, and planning-and-lifecycle.

trigger: 5-axis categorization mismatch and LLM distillation omissions
friction: Distillation dropped defect IDs and mismatched declared axis count (4 axes listed under '5 axes' heading).
resolution: Enforced 5-axis domain taxonomy (Axis 1..5 matching all 17 defects), added postProcessMarkdown and validateDefectIntegrity in scripts/headroom-compress.mjs, and codified in planner.md, code-review-and-quality, and headroom-compression.

trigger: code-writing agents training on BE-03 review defects
friction: Code-writing agents were not systematically cross-referencing and trained on the 17 backend defects from BE-03 (DEF-01..DEF-17), risking regression.
resolution: Codified L-028 through L-044 in lessons-learned-registry, added BE-11..BE-14 to rules/backend.md, bound them to Stage 1 & Stage 5 of @agents_backend and @agents_frontend, updated backend and nestjs-best-practices skills Never blocks, and registered in enforcement-map.json.

trigger: evolution of agent system to v2.0 (AG-01)
friction: Legacy python validator was slow (>1s) and missing structural checks; skills lacked evals and standardized trigger descriptions; subagent frontmatter was incomplete; tool hooks lacked contract testing; plan context burned tokens due to full Ukrainian plans being passed to model.
resolution: Built Node.js validator v2 (<200ms) with agents:check; synthesized 62 eval suites with run-skill-evals.mjs; normalized 62 skill descriptions with explicit Use when/Do not use for; registered 7 native subagents with strict YAML frontmatter; implemented PreToolUse/Stop/SessionStart hooks with 12 unit tests; built Dual-Plan architecture (plans/compact/ + plan-manager.mjs); generated AI_BOM.md and increased machine invariant ratio to 62%.

friction: Moving uncompressed plans to plans/completed/ creates redundant heavy files and risks AI agents reading uncompressed Ukrainian plans; models should execute ONLY compressed plans from plans/completed/, and upon completion active plans in plans/active/ should simply be deleted.
resolution: Updated plan-manager.mjs create to author human plan in plans/active/ and compressed brief in plans/completed/<slug>.compressed.md; updated close to delete plans/active/ while retaining the permanent compressed record; updated PreToolUse hook (Rule R5) to block reading plans/active/ and enforce executing plans/completed/*.compressed.md; updated CORE-14, PLAN-01, and AGENT-02.
